hook: The morning protocol is three steps. They protect the only window in the day that is neurologically yours.
body:
**The morning protocol is three steps. They protect the only window in the day that is neurologically yours.**

The first 60 minutes after waking is a distinct cognitive state. Your brain is in an absorptive, undefended mode before the noise of external input loads. Whatever enters that window shapes the attentional tone of the entire day. Phone first means reactive mode first. Someone else's agenda — notifications, metrics, feeds — runs in your head before your own priorities have even formed.

Three steps.

One: phone charges outside the bedroom. This is non-negotiable. It eliminates the reach before it
